steps.label: No record
steps.sub: nobody can see who ran it, when, or what happened

steps.label: Breaks
steps.sub: stops running the moment that one machine is unavailable

steps.label: Inconsistent
steps.sub: different module versions mean different behavior

steps.label: Consistent environment
steps.sub: the same runner image and modules, every run

steps.label: Logged execution
steps.sub: every run recorded — commit, timestamp, full output

steps.label: Reliable triggers
steps.sub: schedule, push, or a manual button — no person needed

code:
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 7 * * MON-FRI"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  run-script:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
caption: Fires at 07:00 UTC every weekday, with a manual button available too.
